diary.detail: Survival is stable — focus on political decisions.
Work roles are directed by settlement authority.

diary.text: How should work be organised? → Assign labour from the centre
diary.detail: We assigned workers according to settlement need.
Those who work the fields keep a greater share of the yield.

diary.text: Who owns the harvest? → Rewarded labour — field workers keep a greater share
diary.detail: We rewarded those who worked the fields with a greater share.
Everyone eats according to the same ration setting.

diary.text: How should rations be allocated? → Equal rations for all
diary.detail: We directed equal rations during the shortage.
Empty housing may be offered to whoever arrives.

diary.text: Who may settle here? → Open door — welcome whoever arrives
diary.detail: We opened the door to whoever arrives.
Newcomers share the same provision terms as everyone else.
We directed equal rations during the shortage.; We opened the door to whoever arrives.; We offered equal provision rather than private wages.

diary.text: Is compensation individual? → Equal provision — same terms as everyone
diary.detail: We offered equal provision rather than private wages.
Unpleasant work rotates so no one bears it alone.

diary.text: Who should clear the drainage ditch? → Everyone takes a turn
diary.detail: We shared the ditch work so everyone took a turn.
